designs.brief: F-t3-044 inline interactive outputs and F-t3-045 MCP Apps / elicitation forms (plan section '### EP-4 Inline outputs and MCP Apps'). First slices: bridge-less static widget render in the opaque-origin sandbox, then the narrow postMessage bridge, then elicitation forms reusing the WS14 pause, then MCP ui:// resources in the existing frame; the dedicated user-content origin is deferred (ADR stub only).

F-t3-046 sharing, replay, export and import and F-t3-064 the public versioned Agent API with origin-tagged runs (plan section '### EP-12 Sharing, export and the public Agent API'). First slices: origin and parent id on every run, the API-key to audience-bound bearer exchange contract with Control (auth-core), the public lifecycle surface over the existing model-gateway run routes with OpenAPI; export of non-ZDR threads; ZDR threads refuse share/replay/export; Channel Plane stays docs-only.
